title: Tank Drift Ace
description: Steer a nimble mini-tank around destructible battlefields—dodge mortar shells, upgrade double cannons, and blast rival armor into smithereens.
controls: Drag to maneuver your tank while auto-aiming and firing shells at enemy turrets and tanks.

zh-CN.title: 我坦克开得贼溜
zh-CN.description: 抖音爆款动作射击我坦克开得贼溜：单指灵活操控小坦克风骚走位躲炮弹，升级双管加农炮横扫敌军装甲团！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动摇杆操控坦克灵活闪避弹幕，自动瞄准开火摧毁全场敌军坦克与炮台。
